items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: then me, and my brother Maurice

ctx.x: Imagine. There's a good deal of difference in the ages of the children, because Dutch is much younger than you.

Well, you see, you're counting Dutch, but what about the ones before Dutch? You had my sister, then a brother Stanley, then me, and my brother Maurice, then Dutch, then Leo. I mean, she's the youngest, Dutch?
